scope: Forty routine/component candidates selected from the pinned catalogue, not forty distinct papers or forty supported analyses.
selection_basis: Manual engineering prioritization using catalogue identity, public metadata, literal dependency signals and known Ravel gaps; not full paper-by-paper scientific review.

effort_definition.bounded: Relatively constrained adapter/control work after a compatible runtime and frozen sample exist; no claim of easy paper closure.
effort_definition.substantial: New response, category, statistical mapping or nontrivial dependency validation.
effort_definition.new-domain: New scientific modeling assumptions, event types or response infrastructure; requires separate physicist-approved scope.

wave_definition.1: Frozen-event ATLAS/CMS and ordinary SimpleAnalysis controls first.
wave_definition.2: Detector, object, tagger, shape and compressed-search validation.
wave_definition.3: Lifetime, nuclear, flavor, forward and neutrino domain admission.

interpretation_limits: Experiments are proposed and have not been run.
Effort labels are relative engineering judgments, not time estimates or physics-validation scores.
A frozen-event match to an upstream routine establishes implementation agreement only.
Paper-level reproduction also requires matched simulation, normalization, uncertainties and reference agreement.
Publication links are inherited metadata, not proof that every paper or likelihood was read.
No likelihood bytes were acquired or verified in this target-selection task.
The three disappearing-track variants and centrality helper are components, not independent paper reproductions.

unfilled_domains.status: No routine confidently identified from this snapshot metadata; additional official source discovery required.
unfilled_domains.needed: Locate the public routine/reference and establish target species, laboratory-to-CM transform and fixed-target event input before assigning a validation target.
unfilled_domains.non_substitution: LHCb pPb collider and decay analyses in this list do not cover fixed-target physics.
